test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 'The Man Who Made The Elephant Dance' is an autobiography of the famous entrepreneur ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr Verghese Kurien.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Man Who Made the Elephant Dance, by **Dr** **Verghese Kurien**, is the authorized audio-autobiography of the Father of the White Revolution. 
 
• This audiobook, in the **voice of Tom Alter, narrates the glorious saga of the globally acclaimed entrepreneur, Dr. Verghese Kurien.**
 
• **Nirmala Kurien** shared her **childhood memories with her father of how he always believed in equal opportunity for all and excellence in any work that you do.**
 
• The participants shared their** memories and experiences that they had while working with Dr. Kurien.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d051330bda828a44b8051d604475553b6e1a553030c52f1cc17f6a130e2f8b5.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**Ratan Tata** continues to **head the main two Tata trusts Sir Dorabji Tata and Allied Trusts and Sir Ratan Tata Trust and their allied trusts**, with a combined stake of 66% in Tata Sons, Tata group's holding company. 
 
• **Mukesh Ambani **is the firstborn **son of Dhirubhai Ambani,** the **creator of Reliance Industries**, one of the biggest private companies in India, with interests in refining, oil & gas, petrochemicals, telecom, retail and media. Mukesh Ambani **owns approximately 45% of Reliance Industries**, making his net worth roughly** US$ 24 billion.**
 
• **Ghanshyam Das Birla **was the Founder of **Birla Brothers Limited**, a leading producer of tea, textiles, cement, chemicals, rayon, steel tubes, among others.
